Maya (CSM): Heads-up: NovaCorp dedicated rollout is Thu 09:00 PST. Goals: steady 600 RPS, 30s spikes to ~2000, and a clean handoff to their ops team. Please confirm quotas, autoscale, and a short enablement doc.

Jon (SRE): noted. Contract shows 10 reserved GPUs, can allow +15% burst. I'll put a 24h slot lock and a soft-throttle at 75% GPU mem. Need p95 token lengths to size slots.

Ravi (Infra Eng): From sampling p50=70 tokens, p95=220, avg request ~310 tokens. Recommend slot max_seq=512, min_slots=3, scale_step=2, cooldown=120s. We'll add fallback to quantized-v2 if latency spikes >500ms for 3 windows. Pre-warm KV cache via small priming job before the window.

Elena (Solutions Eng): Load plan: smoke 10m @60-90 RPS, soak 2h @600 RPS, then spike script: ramp 15s -> 2k, hold 30s, drop 45s. Use loadgen v1.4 with token-level tracing. I'll share the exact commands in a follow-up.

Maya (CSM): I'll schedule the 09:00 PST call, include billing and renewals for visibility. Action items: Ravi apply autoscale + priming (EOD), Jon set throttle + slot lock (AM), Elena run load scripts. ops-bot please reminder for Thu 09:00 PST.

ops-bot: reminder set: "NovaCorp dedicated bring-up" Thu 2024-03-21T16:00:00Z. Post-run summary will be auto-uploaded to this thread. :white_check_mark:
